description: Speechmatics (Cantab Research Limited) is a speech recognition company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Cambridge, UK. It sells batch and realtime speech-to-text in 55+ languages, deployable in its cloud or on-premise. SaaS endpoints are in the EU, US and Australia.
